description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the DetectRibFracture operation
description_zh: 本文介绍肋骨骨折检测DetectRibFracture的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess detect-rib-fracture --data-format DICOM --org-name '测试组织' --org-id 7ff51bfe-e73d-11ea-827d-506b4b3f3cf6 --source-type HTTP_FILES --url-list URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/0001.dcm --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetectRibFracture

parameters.help_en: The format of the image. Only the following two formats are supported: DICOM and NIFTI
parameters.help_zh: 图像的格式。目前只支持以下两种：DICOM、NIFTI
parameters.name: data_format

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source institution
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en: The code of the data source institution
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the input data. Valid values: `HTTP_FILES` and `HTTP_NII`.

`HTTP_FILES`: sequence files.
`HTTP_NII`: a single file
parameters.help_zh:
输入数据的类型，支持`HTTP_FILES`和`HTTP_NII`。

`HTTP_FILES`为序列文件。
`HTTP_NII`为单个文件
parameters.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1&URLList.2.URL=url2&... Replace url1, url2, and other values as needed. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate URLList
fields.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and deserialize the Result field from JSON to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

items.description_en: The fracture detection bounding box in the image coordinate system, arranged in the following order: (minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ)
items.description_zh: 图像坐标系下骨折检测框，以这个顺序排列：(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ)

items.description_en: The fracture detection bounding box in the physical coordinate system, arranged in the following order: (minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ)
items.description_zh: 物理坐标系下骨折检测框，以这个顺序排列：(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ)

FracSOPInstanceUID.description_en: The unique identifier of the middle frame of the fracture in the entire DICOM sequence. If the input is in NIFTI format, this value is set to None by default
FracSOPInstanceUID.description_zh: 骨折中间帧在整个DICOM序列中的唯一标识符，如果是NIFTI格式的输入，默认设置为None

FractureCategory.description_en:
The fracture classification result. Valid values:

1: Displaced fracture.
2: Non-displaced fracture.
3: Cortical buckle.
4: Old fracture
FractureCategory.description_zh:
骨折分类结果。

1：移位骨折。
2：非移位骨折。
3：皮质弯曲。
4：陈旧骨折

FractureConfidence.description_en: The confidence level of the fracture classification

FractureId.description_en: The sequence number of the fracture, starting from 1

FractureLocation.description_en: The rib number where the fracture is located (L1 to L12, R1 to R12). L indicates the left side, and R indicates the right side
FractureLocation.description_zh: 骨折所在肋骨编号(L1~L12，R1~R12)。L表示左侧，R表示右侧

FractureSegment.description_en:
The rib segment where the fracture is located. Valid values:

0: anterior segment
1: axillary segment
2: posterior segment
FractureSegment.description_zh:
骨折所在肋骨段。取值如下：

0：前段
1：腋段
2：后段

items.description_en: The position of the pixel coordinate system origin in the physical coordinate system
items.description_zh: 像素坐标系原点在物理坐标系中的位置

ResultURL.description_en: The download URL of the segmentation result. The URL is valid for 5 minutes
ResultURL.description_zh: 分割结果下载地址，有效时间5分钟

items.description_en: The physical distance interval between each pixel
items.description_zh: 每个像素之间的物理距离间隔

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
